_note: The Nitro agent marketplace: every agent we have or plan, so teams can find, reuse and showcase them. status: live (in the app today), beta (partly built), planned (next releases).

agents.name: Coordinator
agents.summary: Plans the whole job, picks the next step and hands work to the other agents.
agents.showcase: Shows how one URL turns into a full pre-sales package with no manual steps.

agents.name: Market Researcher
agents.summary: First step of the journey: reads the latest news, analyst notes and market reports on the company, then says what we can do about each signal.
outputs: What we can do for each
agents.showcase: The pitch opens with what keeps their leadership up at night, not with our capabilities.

agents.name: Tender Scout
agents.summary: Watches government tender portals and RSS feeds, and triages each tender for relevance to our skills before the agents pick it up.
builtWith: Simulated on the home dashboard today
agents.showcase: Government work found and filtered before anyone has to read a tender document.

agents.name: Site Auditor
agents.summary: Opens the site in a real browser, takes snapshots and builds a report card with evidence.
agents.showcase: A clear report card a CTO or CMO understands in one glance.

agents.name: Tech Detector
agents.summary: Reads network traffic, headers and cookies to find the front end, back end, CMS, commerce, analytics, CDN and cloud in use.
agents.showcase: Front end to back end to DevOps, mapped to the people we have.

agents.name: Speed Tester
agents.summary: Measures page speed and Core Web Vitals on a mobile profile.
agents.showcase: Hard performance numbers, not opinions.

agents.name: Mobile Tester
agents.summary: Reloads the page at phone size and checks layout, tap targets and text size.
agents.showcase: Shows the prospect what their customers see on a phone.

agents.name: Accessibility Checker
agents.summary: Checks the page against WCAG rules so it works for everyone.
agents.showcase: Compliance and inclusion risks, found automatically.

agents.name: UX Reviewer
agents.summary: Looks at a screenshot like a designer would and scores it against a fixed rubric.
agents.showcase: LLM scores with reasons, checked against a rubric.

agents.name: AI-Search Checker
agents.summary: Checks if AI assistants and AI search can find and quote the site.
agents.showcase: A new risk most prospects have not thought about yet.

agents.name: Designer
agents.summary: Takes the prospect's own colours, fonts and content and builds an improved homepage in HTML, then has it re-audited.
agents.showcase: The prospect sees their own site, improved, before they sign.

agents.name: Team Matcher
agents.summary: Matches the work to developers who are free now and estimates effort and price.
agents.showcase: Turns time between projects into a staffed, priced proposal.

agents.name: Deck Writer
agents.summary: Writes a personalised pitch deck and proposal from the real results.
agents.showcase: A send-ready pitch in minutes instead of days.

agents.name: LLM Scorer
agents.summary: Gives every page, design and journey step an LLM score with reasons, using the same rubric each time.
agents.showcase: Comparable scores across hundreds of sites.

agents.name: Journey Runner
agents.summary: Walks key user journeys like a real customer: search, product page, add to cart, checkout, sign-up.
agents.showcase: Shows where real customers get stuck.

agents.name: Test Writer
agents.summary: Turns each journey into automated tests the client can keep running.
agents.showcase: Automated tests handed over on day one.

agents.name: Locale Tester
agents.summary: Runs the site across locales and languages: translations, currency, dates, right-to-left layout and regional pages.
inputs: Locale list (en-IN, hi-IN, en-US, de-DE, ja-JP, ar-AE)
agents.showcase: Global brands see every market in one view.

agents.name: Backend & API Inspector
agents.summary: Checks API speed, errors, caching and security headers behind the page.
agents.showcase: Back-end insight without access to their code.

agents.name: DevOps & Cloud Inspector
agents.summary: Reviews CDN, hosting, compression, HTTP versions, TLS and cache rules.
agents.showcase: DevOps and cloud improvements our people can deliver.

agents.name: HTML Fixer
agents.summary: Writes ready-to-use HTML and CSS fixes for the top findings: alt text, meta tags, structured data, contrast.
agents.showcase: Proof we can fix it, not just find it.

agents.name: Chat Builder
agents.summary: Builds a simple RAG chat assistant from the prospect's own pages, as a live demo.
agents.showcase: An AI feature the prospect can try in the first meeting.

agents.name: Meeting Assistant
agents.summary: Gives a two-minute brief on a CTO's site during a live meeting.
agents.showcase: Answers in the meeting, not a week later.

agents.name: Outreach Writer
agents.summary: Writes a short, personal note to the CTO based on the real findings.
outputs: Personalised email draft (human approves before sending)
agents.showcase: Reach many CTOs quickly, each with a message about their own site.

agents.name: Night Watch
agents.summary: Runs in the background 24x7, re-checks a watchlist of prospects and flags when a site gets slower or changes.
agents.showcase: Hundreds of analyses a week while the team sleeps.

agents.name: Review Assigner
agents.summary: Assigns each finished run to an available expert with the right skills to review, fine-tune and sign off.
agents.showcase: Engages our people and adds expert judgement to every pitch.
